messages:
Marta Chen: Hey team — need to lock down enablement for Rainfall ahead of their renewal. Account flagged medium risk; they want hands-on help getting inference cost under control and a migration plan for Dedicated. Thinking: 2 office-hours + 1 hands-on micro-lab. Proposed slots:
- Option 1: Wed Apr 14 16:00–17:30 PT (EMEA-friendly)
- Option 2: Tue Apr 20 06:00–07:30 PT (APAC-friendly)
Who can own the lab build + a short agenda? Also need capacity estimate (seats) and whether we need a staging env for customers.

Devin Park: I can own logistics + invite flow. Recommend 90m for the lab (30m demo, 45m breakouts, 15m wrap). Capacity: cap at 18 seats, max 24 if we add observers. Need a pre-req checklist for their infra & API keys.

Raj Patel: I can run the demo — will show hosted -> dedicated migration and cost comparisons using a sample workload. Can you confirm which model family they run? (gpt-compat or opt-style?) If we need quantization examples I can prepare a short notebook.

Ashley Gomez: Suggest splitting track by persona: one breakout for platform engineers (autoscale, routing policies, KMS) and one for app devs (prompting, streaming, fallback). For renewal pitch, include a one-page summary of expected unit economics post-ops. I can draft that. :memo:

Marta Chen: perfect. Devin — can you create the calendar events once we pick slot? Add "Rainfall_enablement@redwood" as organizer and mark as private. Also include a short intake form: team roles + sample request size + current throughput.

Devin Park: On it. Draft invite + intake form here: https://forms.gle/example-invite (WIP). Will set up two invites and tag as "EMEA" and "APAC".

Raj Patel: For staging env — recommend we provision a jupyter + small model instance they can use for the lab. I'll put the bootstrap script in this thread:
```
# bootstrap minimal test env
git clone https://github.com/redwood/example-k8s-inference.git
cd example-k8s-inference
./deploy.sh --model rwd-small --cpu 4 --gpus 0
```
Need someone from infra to approve ephemeral quota.

onboarding-bot: Calendar invite created (draft): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=rainfall-lab-draft — attendees: Marta Chen, Devin Park, Raj Patel, Ashley Gomez. (Use /finalize when ready)

Ashley Gomez: Quick poll — which slot best for the core Rainfall team? React with :one: for Apr 14 (EMEA) or :two: for Apr 20 (APAC). I'll capture responses and we can finalize by EOD Friday.

Marta Chen: Also tagging @sales-rep (cc) to ensure renewal owner is looped in and we have budget alignment. If we don't hit the engagement target (>=12 active participants in the lab) we'll follow up with 1:1 enablement.

Devin Park: noted. I'll post the final invite + intake 24h before the session and share the breakout assignments. :thumbsup:

Marta Chen: thanks all — small action list: (1) Devin create invites & intake form, (2) Raj prepares demo + bootstrap, (3) Ashley drafts one-pager, (4) Marta will ping sales & set success criteria. Will update thread when invites finalized.
